She also says there is a "huge mismatch" between politicians' warnings about the fiscal outlook and their willingness to embrace the higher taxes and spending cuts she says are needed to address it. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

He also weighs in on the Trump administration's push to obtain state voter-roll data and says there is little evidence of noncitizens voting in US elections, arguing such cases are "minuscule" when they occur.
